note: Alias registry for the spec-conformance matrix. `aliases` are the strings a test title may use for this spec; the joiner resolves them to `id`, so a citation grammar can drift without touching a single requirement row. `sealed: true` means the row list is complete for every section the suite cites, so a citation that resolves to no row is a build failure; `sealed: false` means rows are still being written and an unmatched citation is only reported. See ./README.md.
